answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the relic until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the orchard of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the karst of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
